# Klickspell — Web Engineering & Digital Products Studio

> The craft in every click. Independent web engineering studio specializing in high-performance Shopify stores, custom Headless commerce, Webflow sites, and web applications with guaranteed 90+ mobile Core Web Vitals.

Klickspell is an independent web engineering and digital product studio founded by Atul Bhatt. We partner with ambitious founders, brands, and marketing teams to build bespoke web products with zero technical debt, high-converting architectures, and sub-second mobile page loads.

## Core Services

- [Shopify Speed Optimization](/services/shopify-speed-optimization.html): Guaranteed 90+ Mobile Core Web Vitals, app bloat reduction, sub-second LCP.
- [Custom Shopify Development](/services/custom-shopify-development.html): Bespoke Liquid themes, customizer sections, zero page-builder bloat.
- [How to Remove Zombie Shopify App Code](/blog/how-to-remove-zombie-shopify-app-code.html): Complete engineering playbook for discovering and safely purging orphaned liquid snippets from uninstalled apps.
- [How We Achieved a 99 PageSpeed Score](/blog/how-we-achieved-99-pagespeed-score-case-study.html): Real-world web performance architecture playbook.
- [Headless Commerce & Web Apps](https://klickspell.com/services/headless-commerce): Modular commerce powered by Medusa.js, Next.js, and custom APIs with tailored booking flows (Cal.com), multi-currency Stripe checkouts, and custom ERP workflows.
- [Website Speed & App Bloat Estimator](https://klickspell.com/speed): Free interactive diagnostic tool that audits emulated 4G mobile Core Web Vitals and calculates performance penalties across 25+ third-party scripts.

## Client Case Studies & Work

- [Jaxon Lane Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/jaxon-lane.html): Long-term Shopify development partner for California skincare brand. Built Recharge subscription flows, migrated affiliate attribution to Awin, and engineered AI-ready SEO architecture.
- [Noukai Tokyo Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/noukai-tokyo.html): High-fidelity Webflow marketing site and custom product experience for a Japanese mental performance brand.
- [The Blissful Soul Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/the-blissful-soul.html): Custom headless booking and commerce platform connecting Medusa.js, Cal.com, and bespoke payment routing.
- [Cove & Lane Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/cove-and-lane.html): Bespoke Shopify theme development with custom product filters and bundle builders for a luxury home linen brand.
- [Mogra Media Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/mogra-media.html): Editorial and media platform engineering with custom CMS workflows and lightning-fast page delivery.
- [Pragya Vijh Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/pragya-vijh.html): Personal brand and consulting portal with custom calendar integrations and lead-capture systems.
- [Skillbridge Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/skillbridge.html): High-performance EdTech learning platform engineered for founder Rajesh Durai (ex-VP upGrad) with modular curriculum UX and sub-second loading.
- [DealShare Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/dealshare.html): Corporate and investor relations digital architecture for India's leading social e-commerce unicorn.
- [CallSara AI Case Study](https://klickspell.com/work/callsara-ai.html): Interactive SaaS marketing experience and realistic voice audio demonstration player for autonomous AI voice agents.
